release.name: v1.35.1
release.body:
See [kubernetes-announce@](https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/kubernetes-announce). Additional binary downloads are linked in the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-1.35.md).

See the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-1.35.md) for more details.
release.author: k8s-release-robot

analysis.summary: Kubernetes v1.35.1 是一个紧急补丁版本，主要修复了 v1.35.0 中引入的调度器性能严重回退、kube-proxy 同步回归等关键问题，并包含了 Go 语言安全更新。
key_changes: 紧急禁用导致性能问题的 `SchedulerAsyncAPICalls` 特性门控 - [PR #135904](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/135904)
修复 kube-proxy (ipvs/winkernel) 因同步逻辑变更导致的网络规则更新延迟回归 - [PR #136122](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/136122)
将核心组件构建版本升级至 Go 1.25.6，以修复相关 CVE 漏洞 - [PR #136258](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/136258) 和 [PR #136466](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/136466)
修复 StatefulSet 中 `.status.availableReplicas` 计数延迟，加速滚动更新 - [PR #136097](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/136097)
修复 Windows kube-proxy (winkernel) 中双栈 Service 的负载均衡器共享问题 - [PR #136373](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/136373)
important_bugfixes: 修复 kubelet 中错误使用 `V().Error()` 导致的日志泛滥问题 - [PR #136432](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/136432) - **影响：** 错误日志无视 Verbosity 级别始终打印，干扰监控和排错
修复 `kubectl exec` 中终端大小队列未初始化导致的 Panic - [PR #136280](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/136280) - **影响：** 特定条件下 `kubectl exec` 命令会崩溃
修复 kubeadm 升级时因 `kubeadm-flags.env` 文件内容为空导致的失败 - [PR #136131](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/136131) - **影响：** 特定配置下 kubeadm 集群升级流程会中断
修复 kubeadm 在 `kubeadm join` 时未等待 etcd learner 成员启动就尝试提升其状态的问题 - [PR #136348](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/136348) - **影响：** 可能影响 etcd 集群的稳定性和数据一致性
修复 SELinux 警告控制器对已完成 Pod 发出不必要事件的问题 - [PR #136098](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/136098) - **影响：** 产生无关的警告事件，干扰事件流
security_issues: 升级至 Go 1.25.6，修复 Go 标准库中的多个 CVE 漏洞 - [PR #136258](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/136258) - **风险级别：** 中（取决于具体 CVE 利用条件）
更新构建镜像和基础组件至包含安全修复的版本 - [PR #136466](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/136466) - **风险级别：** 低
performance_improvements: 禁用 `SchedulerAsyncAPICalls` 特性门控，解决因 API 客户端限流导致的调度性能严重下降 - [PR #135904](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/135904) - **提升：** 恢复 v1.35.0 之前的调度器性能基线
修复 kubelet 错误日志级别，避免日志泛滥对系统 I/O 和日志收集系统造成不必要的压力 - [PR #136432](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/136432) - **提升：** 减少无关日志输出，提升日志系统效率
breaking_changes: 无新增的破坏性变更。此版本主要目的是修复 v1.35.0 中的回归问题。
recommendations: **强烈建议所有正在运行或计划升级到 v1.35.0 的集群立即升级到 v1.35.1**，以解决调度器性能回退和 kube-proxy 网络同步问题。
升级前，请确认集群中未显式启用 `SchedulerAsyncAPICalls` 特性门控（该门控在此版本中已被强制禁用）。
对于 Windows 节点集群，此版本修复了双栈 Service 的关键问题，建议优先安排升级。
升级后，观察调度器指标（如调度延迟）和 kube-proxy 日志，确认性能回归问题已解决。
由于包含了 Go 语言安全更新，建议将此版本视为一次重要的安全维护升级。
analysis.risk_assessment: 整体风险评估：**低风险，建议立即升级**。此版本是典型的补丁版本，旨在修复前一个版本（v1.35.0）中引入的严重回归问题，尤其是影响核心组件（调度器、kube-proxy）稳定性和性能的缺陷。升级风险较低，收益（稳定性、安全性修复）显著高于风险。建议的升级时机是尽快在测试环境中验证后，安排生产环境升级。需要特别关注升级后调度性能和网络服务的稳定性是否恢复正常。

135853.body:
Cherry pick of #135400 on release-1.35.

#135400: kubeadm: do not sort extraArgs alpha-numerically

For details on the cherry pick process, see the [cherry pick requests](https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-release/cherry-picks.md) page.

```release-note
kubeadm: when applying the overrides provided by the user using "extraArgs", do not sort the resulted list of arguments alpha-numerically. This allows finer control for flags which have an order that matters, such as, "--service-account-issuer" for kube-apiserver.
```

136432.title: [release-1.35] fix(kubelet): convert V().Error() to V().Info() for verbosity-aware logging
136432.body:
Cherry-pick of #136028 for release-1.35.

## What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

## What this PR does / why we need it:

This PR fixes incorrect usage of `logger.V(N).Error()` across the kubelet package. The go-logr package design causes `Error()` calls to bypass verbosity level checks entirely, meaning these logs are always printed regardless of the configured verbosity level.

## Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

Fixes #136027

xref: #136028 (original PR for master)

## Special notes for your reviewer:

This is a manual cherry-pick because the automated cherry-pick bot doesn't work in k/k repo.

**Files modified (13 files, 21 instances):**
- `pkg/kubelet/allocation/allocation_manager.go`
- `pkg/kubelet/cm/devicemanager/plugin/v1beta1/client.go`
- `pkg/kubelet/cm/dra/plugin/dra_plugin_manager.go`
- `pkg/kubelet/kuberuntime/kuberuntime_container_linux.go`
- `pkg/kubelet/lifecycle/handlers.go`
- `pkg/kubelet/metrics/collectors/cri_metrics.go`
- `pkg/kubelet/pleg/generic.go`
- `pkg/kubelet/prober/prober.go`
- `pkg/kubelet/prober/prober_manager.go`
- `pkg/kubelet/stats/cri_stats_provider.go`
- `pkg/kubelet/stats/helper.go`
- `pkg/kubelet/volumemanager/cache/desired_state_of_world.go`
- `pkg/kubelet/volumemanager/reconciler/reconstruct.go`

## Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
Fixed kubelet logging to properly respect verbosity levels. Previously, some debug/info messages using V().Error() would always be printed regardless of the configured log verbosity.
```

/sig node
/area kubelet

136027.title: Error-level logs incorrectly use verbosity levels
136027.body:
Currently, some components in Kubernetes have been migrated (or partially migrated) to [contextual logging](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/blob/master/keps/sig-instrumentation/3077-contextual-logging/README.md). However, an incorrect pattern was introduced during the migration: Error-level logs are being called with verbosity methods (e.g., .V()).

The underlying package go-logr/logr, which contextual logging relies on, ignores the verbosity level when printing Error-level logs. For example, in the statement `logger.V(8).Error(nil, "Readiness probe already exists for container", "pod", klog.KObj(pod), "containerName", c.Name)`, the error log will be printed regardless of the verbosity level set.

This can lead to error log flooding, which may hinder users' ability to review normal logs for troubleshooting. More critically, according to the [Kubernetes logging policy](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/devel/sig-instrumentation/logging.md#what-method-to-use), logs should only be recorded when the information requires action from an administrator. This directly contradicts the practice of setting verbosity levels for Error logs, as administrators using the default logging level might miss these actionable errors. Therefore, these instances need to be fixed.

Using grep, I identified the following instances in the k/k repository where verbosity levels are incorrectly set for Error logs.
- [ ] /pkg/controller/garbagecollector https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/136040
```
./pkg/controller/garbagecollector/garbagecollector.go:363:			logger.V(5).Error(err, "error syncing item", "item", n.identity)
./pkg/controller/garbagecollector/graph_builder.go:225:		logger.V(4).Error(err, "unable to use a shared informer", "resource", resource, "kind", kind)
```
- [ ] /pkg/controller/resourcequota https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/136040
